concepts.concept: On scheduled Treasury index rebalancing dates, condition a daily ZN entry on a benchmark weight transition and test the next-session return.
concepts.economic_counterparty: Regulated duration-targeting funds must adjust Treasury futures exposure when their benchmark constituent weights change.
concepts.persistence_reason: The demand is tied to an externally scheduled benchmark maintenance obligation and balance-sheet implementation timing.
concepts.cheapest_falsifier: Compare next-session ZN returns after scheduled benchmark weight transitions with unconditional next-session returns.
concepts.transmission_channel: Benchmark weight changes alter the futures quantity required to keep regulated portfolios near their mandated duration target.

evidence_refs.passage_echo: Regulated funds that target fixed duration may trade Treasury futures near scheduled index rebalancing dates when benchmark constituent weights change.

mechanism_atoms.claim: Duration-targeting funds face scheduled benchmark-linked trading demand.
